thread:
Jules M: Hi finance — noticed a charge from 'ConfMerch Ltd' on my corporate card for €310. I didn't buy merch, I did buy conference materials but the vendor submitted an invoice under a different merchant name. Card txn shows without VAT details. Need to reclaim VAT and ensure expense coded to CONF-2026.

Tara S: @Jules M can you attach the conference invoice and your receipt? Also send the merchant descriptor from the card txn (screenshot). We need merchant VAT number to reclaim VAT. If vendor won't provide VAT, we may need the vendor invoice that shows VAT or treat as non-reclaimable.

Jules M: Uploaded invoice (conf_invoice.pdf) and screenshot. Descriptor: CONF-MERCH*012345. Invoice shows VAT line but no VAT reg number. I emailed the vendor asking for their VAT ID — got auto-reply saying support@confmerch.com.

Finance Bot: Reminder: VAT reclaim requires vendor tax ID and a VAT-inclusive invoice. Missing VAT ID delays reclaim. For manual processing, include manager approval and the expense center code.

Leo R: Manager approval: approved for coding to CONF-2026 (Leo R). Jules, can you paste the vendor email thread here once they reply? We'll open a reclaim ticket with accounting.

Jules M: Vendor replied: "Hi Jules — invoice attached, VAT included 21%, VAT reg: BE123456789. Apologies, descriptor mismatch due to payment gateway." Attached updated_invoice.pdf.

Tara S: Great — that's perfect. I'll attach the vendor VAT reg and updated invoice to the reclaim. Two next steps: 1) we'll reclass the corporate card txn to CONF-2026 and attach updated_invoice.pdf; 2) open VAT reclaim ticket with accounting (REF: VAT-2026-92). Expect reclaim processing in 6-8 weeks.

Finance Bot: Ticket VAT-2026-92 created and assigned to Tara S. If reclaim accepted, refund will post to the corporate card and reduce net expense.

Jules M: One more thing — when I tried to submit an expense in Ramp it rejected with "policy: merchant mismatch" because merchant name didn't match the registration for CONF budget. Can someone override that so I can submit now that vendor supplied VAT ID?

Tara S: I'll lift the merchant block for this expense once I attach the new invoice and manager approval. Jules, go ahead and submit, leave a note "merchant updated by finance".

Jules M: Submitted. Ramp URL: https://app.ramp.com/expenses/REDACTED/9921. Note added.

Ramp Support: Internal note: we've accepted the expense submission and applied override flag by request of finance (Tara S). Merchant descriptor updated to CONF-MERCH.

Tara S: Logged VAT-2026-92, attached docs, and set expense status to pending reclaim. Jules, no further action needed unless accounting asks for clarification.

Jules M: Thanks! Also FYI I had one dinner with a partner during the conference — receipt €72. It's client-hosted (partner), pre-approved, so I assume full reimbursement including above per diem is allowed?

Leo R: Confirmed — partner-hosted meals pre-approved by me are reimbursable in full. Mark the meal as "client-hosted" in Ramp and attach the partner invite.

Finance Bot: VAT-2026-92 status: In progress. Estimated close: 6-8 weeks.
